features.name: phase0-setup
features.description: Repo skeleton, pyproject tooling (ruff/black/mypy strict), src/coderag package, ports (Protocol), core domain types, trivial green test, GitHub Actions CI.

features.name: phase1-ingest-pgvector
features.description: CLI `ingest` + naive `query` (dense, top-5). Readers (.md/.py/.toml/.yaml, .gitignore filter), chunkers (fixed/recursive/ast), Embedder port, PgvectorStore adapter. Index a real repo in < 2 min.

features.name: phase2-eval-harness
features.description: Golden dataset v1 (~40 Q/A) in evals/golden, harness.py with deterministic retrieval metrics (recall@5, MRR, nDCG). Baseline documented in README.

features.name: phase3-hybrid-rerank
features.description: BM25 + dense with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, optional cross-encoder reranker over top-20->top-5. Experiment table: dense vs hybrid vs hybrid+rerank.

features.name: phase4-structured-generation
features.description: Prompt builder (few-shot) + Pydantic structured output with exact citations (path:line_start-line_end). Zero citations to non-existent paths over the dataset.

features.name: phase5-observability
features.description: Langfuse self-hosted trace per query (retrieval, rerank, prompt, response, cost, latency).

features.name: phase6-qdrant-adapter
features.description: Second VectorStore adapter (Qdrant) on the same eval suite. Comparative table pgvector vs Qdrant in an ADR.

features.name: phase7-api-compose
features.description: FastAPI (/query, /ingest, /health) + docker-compose (app + postgres/pgvector + langfuse, qdrant profile). End-to-end demo from zero in one command.
